questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Demonstrates practical, beginner-friendly automation with GitHub Actions, OIDC, and AWS serverless deployment, plus rollback strategies.

## Key Concepts
- GitHub Actions with OIDC federation
- IAM role trust and least privilege
- CloudFormation for Lambda/API Gateway
- S3 as artifact store
- CFN rollback on failure and basic health checks

## Code Example
```javascript
name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
permissions:
  id-token: write
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v2
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/GitHubActionsCFNRole
          aws-region: us-east-1
      - uses: aws-actions/cloudformation-deploy@v2
        with:
          stack-name: serverless-api
          template: template.yaml
          no-execute-changeset: true
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test failover and rollback in this pipeline?
- How to extend this with additional environments (dev/stage/prod)?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests cost governance basics and introduces guardrails using Budgets, SNS, Lambda, and CodePipeline integration. Keeps scope beginner-friendly while teaching automation patterns for deployments.

## Key Concepts
- AWS Budgets with FORECASTED alerts
- CostFilters scoping by Service (AmazonAPIGateway)
- CloudWatch alarms tied to budgets
- SNS notifications and Lambda triggers
- CodePipeline integration to stop an in-flight deployment

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Resources:
  ApiBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    Properties:
      BudgetName: ApiBudget
      BudgetType: Cost
      TimeUnit: MONTHLY
      CostFilters:
        Service: ["AmazonAPIGateway"]
      PlannedBudgetLimits:
        USD: 3
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test this guard in a dry-run without affecting production?
- How would you scale this to multiple pipelines or environments while avoiding false positives?
